title: Grateful Dead Live at Max Yasgur's Farm on 1969-08-16
source: Source: sbd > 8 Track Master Reels @ 15ips (mixed by Mark Linette via Joe Gastwirt) > Dat (44k) - Provided by Rich Gastwirt; Transfer: Dat > Sony PCM-R500 > Sound Devices 744T > wav 16/44.1 - Transfered by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 3 > iZotope RX6 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac16; edited and mastered SIRMick November 2017

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of Woodstock’s five‑song set highlights a scorching Dark Star and extended Lovelight, with solid performance despite minor radio‑interference glitches.
ai_review.review: The recording is sourced from the gastwirt/miller/sirmick soundboard mix, offering a clean and fairly balanced audio picture though it includes occasional radio chatter on High Time and a brief drop‑out. Musically the show shines – St Stephen rolls straight into Mama Tried, Dark Star erupts with intense improvisation, Lovelight stretches to 38 minutes, and High Time features heartfelt vocals, making this one of the more compelling Woodstock performances.

ai_rating.rationale: Three detailed reviews consistently praise the musical performance (especially Dark Star and Lovelight) while noting a generally good soundboard source with only minor technical hiccups, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean and complete SBD mix; clear instrument separation. Notable radio interference on High Time, a two‑second dropout around 24:10, and occasional distortion from an unplanned guest mic, but overall listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A concise five‑song festival set that moves from a truncated St Stephen into Mama Tried, builds into an expansive Lovelight, and closes with High Time; the pacing feels purposeful for a massive outdoor audience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Blistering SG tone cuts through the mix; strong vocal on High Time.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten adds eerie, atmospheric textures during Dark Star.
